concept: S3: presigned URL for temporary access to private objects
tests: Knowing how to grant temporary access to private S3 objects without a public bucket or handing out credentials.
expected: A presigned URL with a short expiry — access uses the signer's permissions, the bucket stays private. Triggers: "limited time", "private objects", "without exposing the bucket", "without distributing credentials".
why_not: Disabling Block Public Access + public-read exposes all objects; handing out IAM user access keys grossly violates least privilege; static website hosting requires public access and has no time limit.
